_note: Corrections applied by merge_wiki.py on top of the fact packs. Key = merged fact id; each field replaces the fact field; "append" adds a sentence to the fact text.

t01b.flag-ctf-rules.append: CORRECTION 2026-11-14: measured on 6 recordings, the capture does NOT need the carrier's own flag on its stand -- a carrier within ~10 m of its own stand scores with its own flag carried by the enemy (stat 18 +1, team +10; t47.ctf-capture-own-flag-away).
